title: Maximo Object Structure Knowledge
description: Per-object knowledge record produced by OSLC discovery. Read by humans and AI tools (Codex/GLM) to build read-only data fetcher applications.

object_structure.description: Maximo integration object structure name, e.g. MXASSET, MXWODETAIL

resource.description: Normalized reliability resource, e.g. asset, workorder

access.description: Observed access result, e.g. http_200, http_403, unknown

endpoint.description: Canonical OSLC query endpoint for this object structure

primary_key.description: Verified primary-key field. Null until confirmed.

field_candidates.description: Heuristic identifier-like field names (candidates for PK/filters)

important_fields.description: Business field names observed on a minimal sample

method.description: How pagination is performed (curated, e.g. 'oslc.paging + pageno + oslc.pageSize').

single_record_via.description: How a single record is fetched (curated, e.g. 'resource href').

sample.description: Sanitized single record sample. Sensitive/personal fields are redacted or removed.

relationships.description: Verified relationships to other object structures

catalog_source.description: Origin of the catalog entry: live OSLC catalog, documented seed fallback, or OAS-documented (object present in the authenticated OAS but not OSLC-queryable by this account).

data_scope.description: Organizational scope of the observed data, e.g. 'BSR (org IP)'.
